hero.heroPara: Navigating international exams depends on your target study destination, degree level, and medium of instruction, spanning English language proficiency, foreign language diplomas, and graduate admissions tests.

overview: Choosing the right study abroad examination is the crucial first milestone in your international education journey.
The required test depends strictly on your destination country, chosen course discipline, academic level (Undergraduate, Postgraduate, MBA, Medicine), and the teaching language of your degree.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide provides comprehensive diagnostic assessments, cutoff benchmarking, and personalized test selection guidance to ensure students prepare for the exact examination needed.

faqs.q: Should I take IELTS or TOEFL?
faqs.a: Both tests are universally accepted by virtually all top universities. Choose IELTS if you prefer face-to-face speaking interviews, handwriting or typing, and diverse question types. Choose TOEFL if you are comfortable with an all-computer interface, integrated tasks, and typing essays.

faqs.q: Should I take GRE or GMAT for an MBA?
faqs.a: Over 90% of top business schools now accept both GRE and GMAT equally. If you have exceptional quantitative and data analysis skills, GMAT is traditionally favored by management consulting and finance recruiters. If your vocabulary and verbal skills are stronger, GRE is often easier.

faqs.q: Can I study abroad without IELTS or English tests?
faqs.a: Yes, in certain circumstances. Universities in Germany, France, Ireland, and the UK may waive IELTS if your undergraduate medium of instruction (MOI) was English, or if you take alternative tests like Duolingo English Test or PTE Academic.

faqs.q: Which test is the fastest to receive results?
faqs.a: Duolingo English Test (DET) and PTE Academic deliver official certified results within 48 hours. IELTS on Computer delivers results in 1–5 days, while TOEFL iBT results take 4–8 days.
